process.title: Available now: mining, processing, recovery, and retail reimagined.
process.intro: Nevada Mining Resources works in every stage of the gold development process, from mining to retail.
body: NMR uses a unique method to extract gold from properties overlooked by the traditional mining industry.
The proprietary platform mines for gold without the use of chemicals or water. NMR also puts the tailings to work by reformulating unused dirt into bricks and pavers.
Because the mining method does not use chemicals or water, NMR can mine without the years-long permitting process, and can mine in areas previously deemed off-limits.
Smaller plots of land can become profit centers. Gold on inaccessible plots of land can now be discovered. Condemned mines can be reopened, safely, and restored to their chemical-free state.
The innovation continues through the collection of gold and into retail shops that sell and display gold with the flair of a fashion boutique.

participate.title: A platform for investors, land owners, regulators, suppliers, and consumers.
participate.intro: The State of Nevada is described by the legacy site as the largest in mineral riches in the United States and the largest land owner, with almost 90% of land under government management through BLM and other agencies.
body: Since Nevada was surveyed by USGS many years ago, little has changed for smaller gold deposits of more than 5,000,000 ounces.
Without innovative advancements in mining, these deposits will remain buried and of no use or value to the Nevada or US economies.
Nevada Mining Resources offers an innovative platform to make a positive change to the mining industry, and to revitalize and stabilize economies around the world.
